producer_audit.callers: Conversation controller, Conversations maintenance/reaper/home reset, Team, Accounts.Deletion all call terminate_conversation/2; no production atom sender remains.

producer_audit.identity: Lifecycle passes the sandbox used to list co-tenants; wake follow/strand paths pass the old sandbox ID.

producer_audit.retirement: model_rejected receiver was removed in #2113; peers are local to the owning server and exit with it.

hosted_observation.method: Read-only Kubernetes deployment, ReplicaSet and pod inventory; release RPC Node.list on each running pod.
hosted_observation.node_membership: Each node saw only the other ready node; each hidden-node list contained only that inspection RPC client.
hosted_observation.scope: Hosted deployment at observation time only. Full replacement of old VMs drains their conversation owners, local peers and mailboxes. No deployment was changed by these checks.

release_requirements: Keep pre-floor nodes from rejoining, including rollback automation and dormant workloads.
Self-hosted installations must complete and record the two-stage bridge rollout, or stop every old process before starting removal nodes.
Replace server processes; hot code upgrades across this boundary are unsupported.
